description: Two Bernoulli gates: each incoming gate is sent to one of two outputs on the toss of a coin, with the odds set by a knob and a CV input

params.text: Sets the odds of a gate going to the B output rather than the A output, fully clockwise sending every one to B
Switches that channel between passing the incoming gate to whichever output the coin picks, and a toggle mode where the coin chooses only whether to swap outputs and the chosen one stays high

inputs.text: The gate or trigger the first channel routes, read high at 2V; a polyphonic cable is tossed for channel by channel
The gate or trigger the second channel routes, read high at 2V; with nothing patched here it takes the first channel's input
Adds to that channel's probability knob, 10V covering the whole range

outputs.text: Carries a 10V gate when the coin sends the incoming gate to A
Carries a 10V gate when the coin sends the incoming gate to B

menu: Channel 1 mode — sets the first channel to Latch, where the coin sends the incoming gate to one output or the other, or Toggle, where the picked output stays high
Channel 2 mode — sets the second channel to Latch, where the coin sends the incoming gate to one output or the other, or Toggle, where the picked output stays high

inputs.1:
high above 2V · stepped · polyphonic

unpatched it reads the channel 1 input.
